ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is parallelogram JKLM, with J at the upper left, K at the upper right, L at the lower right, and M at the lower left; the two diagonals intersect at R. Diagonal JL divides the interior angle KLM at point L into two labeled angles: the angle near KL is 70°, and the angle near LM is 30°. The figure also labels side lengths JK=2b+3, JM=3a, KL=21, ML=45. Reasoning: The interior angle ∠KLM at point L is composed of 70° and 30°, so m∠KLM = 70° + 30° = 100°. In a parallelogram, adjacent interior angles are supplementary, therefore m∠JKL + m∠KLM = 180°. So m∠JKL = 180° - 100° = 80°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: JKLM is a parallelogram with diagonal JL drawn, and at vertex L the diagonal splits the interior angle KLM into 70° between KL and LJ and 30° between LJ and LM. Add these to get m∠KLM = 100°. Since JKLM is a parallelogram, consecutive interior angles are supplementary, so m∠JKL + m∠KLM = 180°. Therefore m∠JKL = 180° - 100° = 80°.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: triangle JKL is formed by side JK, side KL, and diagonal JL. At L, the angle between KL and JL is labeled 70°. Also, because JK is parallel to ML in parallelogram JKLM, the angle between JK and JL at J equals the angle between ML and JL at L, which is labeled 30°. Thus in triangle JKL, two angles are 70° and 30°, so m∠JKL = 180° - 70° - 30° = 80°.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是平行四边形 JKLM，顶点 J 在左上，K 在右上，L 在右下，M 在左下。上边 JK 标为 2b+3，左边 JM 标为 3a，右边 KL 标为 21，下边 ML 标为 45。对角线 JL 和 MK 相交于 R。在点 L 处，JL 与 ML 之间标有 30°，JL 与 KL 之间标有 70°。
推理：考虑三角形 JKL。因为 JKLM 是平行四边形，所以 JK ∥ ML。对角线 JL 是一条截线，因此 ∠KJL 等于点 L 处 ML 与 JL 形成的 30°。图中点 L 处 KL 与 JL 形成的角是 70°，即 ∠JLK = 70°。三角形 JKL 的内角和为 180°，所以 m∠JKL = 180° - 30° - 70° = 80°。
